reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Issuer v1 schema: 1 field added: `spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The new field is optional and can be adopted by users configuring Azure DNS solvers with managed identity authentication; existing configurations without this field continue to work.

proposed.statement: A new optional field spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID was added to the Issuer v1 schema.
